question: What measure corresponds to the staff length at the pole tip relative to the earth-entered portion?
premises: A portion of the pole is entered into the earth.
That earth-entered portion constitutes a specific measure.
The staff length at the pole tip is identified with that measure.
inference: The length of the staff at the pole's tip is determined by the measure of the portion that has entered the earth.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between daṇḍa-agre and yaṣṭi-dairghyakam depends on the broader measurement procedure in surrounding verses.
plain_english: The measure that has entered the earth is the length of the staff at the tip of the pole.
